    • generalSecurity

      public static SecurityFault generalSecurity(String summary, String detail, Throwable cause)
      Report a general security issue not elsewhere specified below.
      Parameters:
      summary - The summary message, should be the same in all cases where the issue is the same
      detail - The detailed part of the message, provides specifics for each case
      cause - The cause of the exception
      Returns:
      A new security fault ready to be thrown
